ruleDefinitions.name: Potential SysInternals ProcDump Evasion
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects uses of the SysInternals ProcDump utility in which ProcDump or its output get renamed, or a dump file is moved or copied to a different name

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*copy\\ procdump.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*move\\ procdump.*")) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*copy\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dmp\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*2\\\.dmp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*lsass.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*out\\\.dmp.*"))) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*copy\\ lsass\\\.exe\\_.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*move\\ lsass\\\.exe\\_.*")))
